zh: GitHub 限制了这个网络的访问次数（不登录每小时 60 次）。过一会儿再刷新。
en: GitHub has limited requests from this network (60 per hour without signing in). Refresh again in a while.

zh: 连不上 GitHub，排名暂时看不了。这一局的成绩已经存在这台设备上，不受影响。
en: Cannot reach GitHub, so the ranking is unavailable for now. Your result for this episode is already saved on this device and is not affected.
No one is on the board for §0§ yet.
On the board for §0§: §1§. Your rank: §2§.

zh: §0§有 §1§ 个人上榜。把你的成绩贴上去的话，排第 §2§（共 §3§ 人）。
en: On the board for §0§: §1§. If you post your result, your rank will be §2§ (out of §3§).
Shown below is what was fetched last time.

zh: 正在从 GitHub 取大家的成绩…

en: Post my result to the board
Copy the link to this episode

zh: 在刚打开的 GitHub 页面里点 Create（要先登录 GitHub 账号，成绩会以这个账号公开显示）。提交之后回到这里点"刷新"；GitHub 那边有时要等一两分钟才取得到。
en: On the GitHub page that just opened, click Create (you need to be signed in to GitHub; your result will be shown publicly under that account). Then come back here and click "Refresh"; it can take GitHub a minute or two to make it available.

zh: 榜上的每一条都在你的浏览器里照着交来的动作重放过，得分以重放的为准。种子是公开的，先看完整局再回头挑动作的人拦不住，所以这个榜只图个乐。
en: Every entry on the board has been replayed in your browser from the submitted actions, and the score shown is the replayed one. The seed is public, so nothing stops someone from looking at the whole episode first and then choosing their actions; the board is just for fun.

zh: 每天一局，全站的人打的是同一局；换日在 UTC 0 点（北京时间早上 8 点），离下一局还有 §0§。只有这一次机会，打到一半关掉可以接着打。
en: One episode a day, the same one for everyone on the site. The day changes at 00:00 UTC (08:00 Beijing time); the next episode starts in §0§. You get one attempt, and if you close this halfway you can pick it up again.

zh: daily 每天 今日 排名 榜
全站每天打同一局。打完看自己排在所有人的哪个位置，再和最优规则在同一局上比。
en: Everyone on the site plays the same episode each day. When you finish, see where you rank among all players, then compare with the best rule on the same episode.
